card.name: Occlusive dressing and similar word starts
card.fires_on: Mostly on the 'clusive' part of 'occlusive' in 'occlusive dressings', and on odd spots right before an expected 'ad...' or 'oc...' word. Also on 'Pent' at the start of pentoxifylline or pentazocine.

modes.label: Occlusive dressing
modes.description: The 'clusive' ending of 'occlusive' in skin-cream instructions about dressings.
